recurring_harms: discrimination; missed opportunity; injury when oversight is weak; trusting a vendor score too much
human_in_loop_decisions: Hiring: a human must own reject and interview. Healthcare: a person must still act if the bedside picture disagrees with a sepsis score. Mobility: a safety driver or disengage path must be real not a sticker.
strongest_guardrails: No auto-reject in hiring; measure the model ourselves not only the vendor slide; named person who can pause; keep logs
cross_industry_pattern: From class cases I saw the same intern lesson: the model is not the whole product. Rules vendor settings and weak human review can hurt people first. Do not raise automation until fallback and independent checks exist.
